_comment: Yas Marina. NONE of these are measured. The racing team never supplied calibration files. See docs/calibration-limitation.md before trusting any metric output derived from this file.
_comment_fx_projection: Deliberately separate from fx. tools/build_lidar_gt.py and tools/project_lidar.py place LiDAR points on pixels with 640.0, and that combination is the one validated by overlay. fx above is 1280.0. Both are guesses and they disagree by 2x; changing fx_projection to match fx would move every projected point. Resolve only with a real calibration.
_comment_fxb_recovered: The product fx*B recovered from data by 'build_lidar_gt.py recover', which writes it here. Only the PRODUCT sets disparity scale, so it is stored as one number: splitting it into fx and baseline would invent a baseline that was never measured. null means recovery has not been run. Do not substitute fx*baseline from the fields above; that product is 409.6 and is an estimate, not a measurement.
_comment_nose_rects: Vehicle geometry, full-frame pixel coords (x1, y1, x2, y2). Pixels inside these never receive ground truth: the camera sees the car's own bodywork there while LiDAR sees the scene behind it, which would otherwise corrupt the GT.
